name: rusty-procgen
description: Deterministic dungeon generation, validation, and inspection workbench for Rusty Engine consumers.

scripts.batch:sample: npm run procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10
scripts.geometry:recovery: cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path procgen-rs/Cargo.toml --bin rusty-procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10 && npm run geometry:recovery:report
scripts.viewer:serve:regenerate: npm run baseline && npm run batch:sample && npm run build:viewer && node scripts/serve-viewer.mjs
scripts.viewer:smoke: npm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/legacy-asha-voxel-inspection-frame-smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke-viewer.mjs
scripts.policy:smoke: npm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && node scripts/smoke-placement-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-geometry-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-corridor-realization-experiment.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:migration-boundary && npm run check:corpus-identity && npm run engine:revision && npm run typecheck && npm run engine:publication:test && npm run engine:spatial:test && npm run rust:test
scripts.verify: npm run check:migration-boundary && npm run check:corpus-identity && npm run engine:revision && npm run typecheck && npm run engine:publication:test && npm run engine:publication:clippy && npm run publish:rusty-engine-smoke && npm run engine:spatial:test && npm run engine:spatial:clippy && npm run voxel:rusty-engine-smoke && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && npm run rust:check && npm run rust:test
